headline: Singapore GP: Verstappen wins from pole. Antonelli leads by 102 points
whyCareReason: Formula1.com has Verstappen first, Leclerc 7.335 seconds back and Antonelli 24.573 back. Antonelli has 340 points.
teaser: 62 laps in 1:42:00.785. Russell finished ninth from 19th on the grid.
story: Max Verstappen won the Singapore Grand Prix from pole. The official time is 1:42:00.785 for 62 laps. Charles Leclerc was second at +7.335s. Kimi Antonelli was third at +24.573s. Verstappen also won the sprint. George Russell started 19th and finished ninth. The drivers' standings: Antonelli 340, Russell 238, Hamilton 229, Verstappen 221, Leclerc 215, Norris 201. Mercedes have 578 constructors' points, Ferrari 444.
stakes: Antonelli's lead over Russell is 102 points. Verstappen is fourth, 119 behind the leader.
rivalryAngle: A first Marina Bay win for Verstappen, and a podium that widened the championship gap.
funFacts: Antonelli 340, Russell 238. The gap is 102 points on the official standings.
Russell started 19th, finished ninth, and scored two points. Hadjar scored the last point in 10th.
